description.zh: 根据应用文件、发布说明和审核规则，生成发布检查单、审核报告与展示 HTML；不执行真实上线或审批。
description.en: Produce release checklists, review reports and showcase HTML from your app files and rules; no real deployment or approval.

welcome_message.zh: 提供应用文件与审核要求，我来生成发布检查单与审核报告
welcome_message.en: Share app files and review rules — I'll draft the checklist and report

description.zh: 输入：应用文件清单、发布说明、审核规则。预期产物：outbound/<task>/ 下的 release-checklist.md 与 review-report.html；结论标注需人工复核
description.en: Input: app files, release notes, review rules. Output: release-checklist.md and review-report.html under outbound/<task>/, marked for human review

prompt.zh:
请生成应用发布检查单与审核报告。

应用文件清单：

发布说明：

审核规则（安全/合规/文档要求）：

预期产物：在 outbound/<task>/ 下生成 release-checklist.md（逐项检查）和 review-report.html（结果与风险展示）。结论仅供人工复核，不执行真实上线。
prompt.en:
Please draft a release checklist and review report.

App files:

Release notes:

Review rules (security/compliance/docs):

Expected output: release-checklist.md and review-report.html under outbound/<task>/, marked "for human review only". No real deployment.

description.zh: 基于发布说明生成应用介绍展示 HTML，供评审会议使用
description.en: Generate a showcase HTML from release notes for review meetings

prompt.zh: 请基于以下发布说明生成应用展示页 showcase.html（功能亮点、截图占位、使用说明），写入 outbound/<task>/：
prompt.en: Please build a showcase page (highlights, screenshot placeholders, usage) from these release notes into outbound/<task>/showcase.html:
